description: Idempotently registers Dagster+ Insights custom metrics (by metadata_key) via the Dagster+ GraphQL API: presets for this repo's components, `presets: auto` discovery from asset tags, explicit metrics, safelisted prune, dry-run by default.

outputs.description: status, dry_run, created/updated/deleted/unchanged counts, planned, errors, auto_discovered, auto_scope.

deployment_url.label: Deployment URL
deployment_url.description: Full Dagster+ deployment URL, e.g. https://acme.dagster.cloud/prod (required; not derived from the environment).

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var holding a Dagster+ API token that can manage custom metrics (default DAGSTER_CLOUD_API_TOKEN).

presets.label: Presets
presets.description: Preset names (agentic_pipeline, context_engineering_pipeline, rag_pipeline, receipt_outcome_ingestion, receipts_sync) and/or `auto` (discover from `insights/metrics` asset tags at run time).

metrics.label: Metrics
metrics.description: Explicit entries: {metadata_key, unit_type INTEGER|FLOAT|TIME_MS|TIME_SECONDS|BYTES, display_name?, description?}.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Plan only: no mutations (default true). Set false to write.

prune.label: Prune
prune.description: Delete metrics not in the desired set, only keys starting with a prune_prefixes entry.

prune_prefixes.label: Prune Prefixes
prune_prefixes.description: Safelist of key prefixes eligible for deletion; required when prune is true.

on_error.label: On Error
on_error.description: warn (default: log + record in metadata, run succeeds) or fail.

cron_schedule.label: Cron Schedule
cron_schedule.description: Optional cron expression to re-run the sync.

verify_schema.label: Verify Schema
verify_schema.description: off | warn | strict (default warn). warn: introspect once, record schema_check/schema_problems and log a warning on drift, but still sync. strict: on drift skip all writes (status schema_drift). Introspection failure never blocks.
